title: ScriptureSeedBatch
description: Represents a batch of financially-themed, fully-validated Bible scripture records pushed to the BibleFi dApp by the dapp_seeder agent during a single hourly execution cycle.

batch_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this seed batch (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the ScriptureSeedBatch schema (e.g. '1.0.0').

run_id.description: UUID of the AgentRunLog record for the hourly cycle that produced this batch.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the batch. 'seeded' indicates all records were successfully pushed to the dApp.

scripture_record_ids.description: Ordered list of ScriptureRecord UUIDs included in this batch. All records have passed both cross-language and theological validation.

financial_themes.description: Union of all financial theme keywords matched across the records in this batch (e.g. 'debt', 'tithe', 'stewardship', 'mammon', 'treasure').

translation.description: Translation metadata for the primary language of records in this batch.

language.description: BCP-47 language tag for the translation (e.g. 'en').

target_dapp.description: Details of the BibleFi dApp endpoint that received this batch.

endpoint_url.description: Base URL of the BibleFi dApp API endpoint receiving the scripture seed.

api_version.description: Version of the dApp API used to push this batch (e.g. 'v1').

response_status.description: HTTP status code returned by the dApp endpoint for the seeding request.

records_count.description: Total number of ScriptureRecord documents included in this batch.

records_seeded.description: Number of records successfully acknowledged by the dApp.

records_failed.description: Number of records that the dApp rejected or could not process.

seeded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the dApp acknowledged receipt of this batch.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this batch record was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this batch record was last updated.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for filtering or audit purposes.
